items.title: Meta搶先OpenAI進軍AI硬體「Muse Charm」鑰匙圈最快12月上市
items.title_en: Meta Beats OpenAI to AI Hardware with "Muse Charm" Keychain Set to Launch as Early as December
paras: Meta Platforms (META-US)正在加速將人工智慧從手機App帶進專用硬體，執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)在年度Connect大會上公布Muse Charm，一款可掛在鑰匙圈上的小型AI裝置，讓使用者不必解鎖手機或開啟App，就能直接與Meta的AI代理Muse互動。
Meta預計在今年12月推出Muse Charm，這也讓公司在消費型AI硬體市場搶在OpenAI之前亮相。
Muse Charm是Meta將Muse從軟體服務延伸至實體裝置的重要一步。裝置體積接近口袋大小，配備約2吋螢幕、指紋感測器與5G數據機，螢幕主要顯示Muse的角色，而非像智慧型手機般運行各種App。使用者可以透過語音、觸控及相機與Muse互動，指紋感測則提供啟動方式。Meta尚未公布Muse Charm售價，目前也僅製作少量原型機，預計在正式上市前完成產品定型。
Muse Charm背後真正的核心並非硬體，而是Meta希望建立的個人AI代理。Muse於9月8日推出，能代表使用者執行多步驟任務，例如撰寫及寄送電子郵件、安排旅行、處理表格、購物，甚至代表使用者進行部分交易。Muse目前提供免費版本，另有每月20美元及100美元的訂閱方案，分別面向一般及高強度使用者。
Muse推出後初期成長速度相當快。根據App數據公司Apptopia資料，Muse在上市前12天累計下載量達280萬次；若採用相同口徑比較，ChatGPT同期約為130萬次。Muse目前僅在美國及加拿大提供下載，但早期用戶反應已成為市場重新評估Meta AI策略的重要因素。
Reuters報導指出，Muse推出後Meta股價一度累計上漲逾20%, 市值增加超過2000億美元，並升至7個多月來高點。市場對Muse的早期採用速度及商業化潛力反應積極，不過這些市場表現主要反映投資人對未來AI收入的預期，尚不能代表Muse已經建立長期且可持續的商業模式。
Jefferies估計，如果Muse到2027年底能達到10億名用戶，並有至少3%的用戶轉換為付費方案，年化營收可能達到108億美元。這項數字屬於券商情境估算，而非Meta公布的財測。J.P. Morgan則認為，Muse具備成為ChatGPT推出後最廣泛使用的消費型AI應用之一的潛力，主要原因包括多步驟任務能力、Meta龐大的既有用戶基礎，以及免費方案降低使用門檻。
Meta的AI策略並不只依賴Muse App。公司表示，Muse將在未來數月導入AI眼鏡，讓使用者可以直接透過眼鏡呼叫AI代理，並讓Muse根據使用者眼前看到的商品、傳單或其他物體採取行動。Meta預計到今年底，旗下Ray-Ban、Oakley及Meta品牌AI眼鏡的款式將超過100種。

在Connect大會上，Meta也宣布擴大Muse的外部服務整合，包括Walmart、Best Buy、American Eagle Outfitters、DICK'S Sporting Goods、Fanatics、Gap、Michael Kors、Sephora、Ulta及Wayfair等零售商，並加入Shop Pay及PayPal作為支付工具。Expedia將用於旅遊規劃，Instacart則可協助採購食品，另外還將連接Notion、Granola、GitHub及Box等工作工具。
Meta同時為每個Muse代理提供專屬電子郵件地址，讓AI代理能透過電子郵件處理任務或與使用者溝通。公司還公布即時語音對話、自訂聲音及Live Video等功能，試圖讓Muse從傳統聊天機器人進一步轉型為能夠持續代表使用者執行任務的個人AI代理。
這套策略也讓Meta在消費型AI硬體領域暫時取得時間優勢。OpenAI已投入數十億美元建立硬體部門，並與前蘋果(Apple, AAPL-US)首席設計長Jony Ive合作開發新型AI裝置，但目前尚未公布正式產品。市場目前預期OpenAI的首款裝置可能要到2027年才會推出，因此Meta搶先公開Muse Charm，等於提前進入這個仍未形成明確產品標準的新市場。
祖克柏對AI硬體的押注其實也延續Meta過去多年的硬體策略。公司先前投入大量資金發展虛擬實境、擴增實境及智慧眼鏡，並將Reality Labs視為下一代運算平台的重要布局。不過，這些業務長期處於高投入階段，Muse則讓Meta有機會把既有硬體生態與AI服務結合，形成不同於單純販售裝置的商業模式。
Meta第二季營收達608.01億美元, 年增28%; 營業利益187.75億美元, 年減8%; 淨利158.48億美元, 年減14%。截至6月底, Meta每日活躍用戶達36億人, 年增3%。公司預估2026年資本支出將達1300億至1450億美元, 顯示其AI資料中心、運算基礎設施及新產品開發仍需要極高資本投入。
Meta第二季資本支出達310.8億美元, 同時截至6月底持有現金、現金等價物及有價證券約902.6億美元, 長期債務為836.6億美元。公司也在2026年5月進行人力縮減, 第二季計入11.8億美元遣散費, 截至6月底員工人數為7.55萬人。
不過, Muse與Muse Charm能否真正改變消費者使用AI的方式, 目前仍存在不少未知數。AI硬體過去已有多個案例未能形成大眾市場, 包括Rabbit R1及Humane AI Pin等產品。Muse Charm必須證明自己能提供手機、智慧手錶或AI眼鏡無法輕易取代的功能, 同時還要讓消費者願意將購物、電子郵件、旅遊及其他個人資料交給AI代理處理。
信任問題也是Meta能否擴大Muse商業模式的重要關鍵。Visa近期調查顯示, 美國消費者使用AI助理的比例已達72%, 但願意讓AI直接代為付款的比例僅23%。這代表消費者可能願意使用AI協助搜尋與規劃, 但對於讓AI掌握支付及交易權限仍相對謹慎。

對Meta而言, Muse Charm因此不只是另一款硬體產品, 而是祖克柏試圖建立「個人超級智慧」生態系的實驗。Meta希望讓AI代理成為連接社交、購物、工作、旅遊與日常生活的核心入口, 再透過手機、AI眼鏡及專用裝置提供無縫接觸。如今Meta已在OpenAI正式推出硬體前率先把產品推向市場, 但祖克柏這套以AI代理加上自有硬體建立新消費平台的策略, 最終能否形成大規模使用及穩定收入, 仍有待市場與消費者進一步驗證。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) is accelerating the move of artificial intelligence from mobile apps to dedicated hardware. CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced Muse Charm at the annual Connect conference – a small AI device that can be attached to a keychain, allowing users to interact with Meta’s AI agent Muse without unlocking a phone or opening an app.
Meta plans to launch Muse Charm in December this year, giving the company a first‑mover advantage in the consumer AI‑hardware market ahead of OpenAI.

Muse Charm marks a key step for Meta in extending Muse from a software service to a physical device. The pocket‑sized gadget features a roughly 2‑inch screen, a fingerprint sensor and a 5G modem. The screen mainly displays Muse’s avatar rather than running a suite of apps like a smartphone. Users can interact with Muse via voice, touch and camera, while the fingerprint sensor serves as an activation method. Meta has not disclosed pricing and has only produced a limited number of prototypes, with final product specifications to be locked in before the official launch.

The real core behind Muse Charm is not the hardware but Meta’s personal AI agent. Muse, launched on September 8, can act on behalf of users to perform multi‑step tasks such as drafting and sending emails, planning trips, handling forms, shopping, and even executing certain transactions. Muse is offered for free, with paid tiers of $20 per month and $100 per month aimed at regular and power users respectively.

Muse’s early growth has been rapid. According to app‑analytics firm Apptopia, Muse accumulated 2.8 million downloads in the 12 days before its launch; by the same metric, ChatGPT logged about 1.3 million downloads in the comparable period. Muse is currently available only in the United States and Canada, but early user feedback has already become a key factor in reassessing Meta’s AI strategy.

Reuters reported that Meta’s share price rose more than 20 % after Muse’s debut, adding over $200 billion to market value and reaching a seven‑month high. The market’s enthusiastic response reflects investors’ expectations for future AI revenue, but it does not yet prove that Muse has built a sustainable, long‑term business model.

Jefferies estimates that if Muse reaches 1 billion users by the end of 2027 and at least 3 % convert to paid plans, annual revenue could hit $10.8 billion. This is a brokerage scenario, not a figure disclosed by Meta. J.P. Morgan sees Muse as having the potential to become one of the most widely used consumer AI applications since ChatGPT, citing its multi‑step task capability, Meta’s massive existing user base, and the low barrier of a free tier.

Meta’s AI strategy is not limited to the Muse app. The company says Muse will be integrated into AI glasses in the coming months, allowing users to summon the agent directly through eyewear and have Muse act on items the user sees – such as products, flyers or other objects. Meta expects that by year‑end it will offer more than 100 styles of AI glasses under the Ray‑Ban, Oakley and Meta brands.

At Connect, Meta also announced an expansion of Muse’s external service integrations, adding retailers such as Walmart, Best Buy, American Eagle Outfitters, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Fanatics, Gap, Michael Kors, Sephora, Ulta and Wayfair, as well as payment options Shop Pay and PayPal. Expedia will be used for travel planning, Instacart for grocery ordering, and connections will also be made to productivity tools like Notion, Granola, GitHub and Box.

Meta will assign each Muse agent a dedicated email address so the AI can handle tasks or communicate with users via email. The company also unveiled real‑time voice conversation, custom voice, and Live Video features, aiming to evolve Muse from a traditional chatbot into a personal AI agent that continuously acts on the user’s behalf.

This strategy gives Meta a temporary time advantage in the consumer AI‑hardware space. OpenAI has invested billions in building a hardware division and is collaborating with former Apple chief design officer Jony Ive on a new AI device, but no product has been announced yet. The market expects OpenAI’s first device not until 2027, so Meta’s early reveal of Muse Charm effectively puts it ahead in a market that has yet to settle on clear product standards.

Zuckerberg’s bet on AI hardware continues Meta’s long‑standing hardware playbook. The company has previously poured capital into virtual reality, augmented reality and smart glasses, treating Reality Labs as a next‑generation computing platform. Those businesses remain high‑investment for the long term, while Muse gives Meta a chance to combine its existing hardware ecosystem with AI services, creating a model that differs from pure device sales.

Meta reported Q2 revenue of $60.801 billion, up 28 % year‑over‑year; operating income of $18.775 billion, down 8 %; net income of $15.848 billion, down 14 %. As of June 30, daily active users reached 3.6 billion, up 3 % year‑over‑year. The company forecasts 2026 capital expenditures of $130 billion to $145 billion, indicating continued heavy investment in AI data centers, compute infrastructure and new product development.

Q2 capital spending hit $31.08 billion, and as of June 30 Meta held roughly $90.26 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, with long‑term debt of $83.66 billion. The firm also carried out workforce reductions in May 2026, recording $1.18 billion in severance costs for the quarter, with the employee headcount at 75,500 at month‑end.

Nevertheless, it remains uncertain whether Muse and Muse Charm can truly change how consumers use AI. Past AI‑hardware attempts such as the Rabbit R1 and Humane AI Pin have failed to achieve mass‑market adoption. Muse Charm must prove it can deliver capabilities that phones, smartwatches or AI glasses cannot easily replace, while also convincing users to entrust shopping, email, travel and other personal data to an AI agent.

Trust is another critical factor for scaling Muse’s business model. A recent Visa survey showed that 72 % of U.S. consumers use an AI assistant, but only 23 % are willing to let an AI make payments on their behalf. This suggests users are comfortable with AI for search and planning, yet remain cautious about granting payment and transaction authority.

For Meta, Muse Charm is more than another hardware product; it is Zuckerberg’s experiment in building a “personal super‑intelligence” ecosystem. Meta aims to make AI agents the central hub linking social, shopping, work, travel and daily life, delivering seamless access through phones, AI glasses and dedicated devices. While Meta has moved ahead of OpenAI by launching the product before OpenAI’s hardware debut, the ultimate success of this AI‑agent‑plus‑own‑hardware strategy in generating large‑scale usage and stable revenue will depend on further market and consumer validation.

items.title: 習近平會川普：望美方堅持反台獨 慎重處理台灣問題
items.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Trump: Calls on the U.S. to Uphold Anti‑Taiwan Independence Stance and Handle Taiwan Issue Prudently
paras: 美中元首今年第二度會面，據中國官媒《新華社》報導，中國國家主席習近平周四(24日)在白宮與美國總統川普會晤，強調「維護國家統一」、「領土完整」，要求美方堅持反對台灣獨立，慎重處理台灣問題。同時談到了兩大強權在人工智慧(AI)發展方面，應繼續展開對話，雖存在競爭但「更可以合作」。
以下為《新華社》官方新聞稿：

習近平指出，中美兩國元首在不到半年時間裡實現互訪，在中美關係史上是前所未有的。我和川普總統一直通過各種方式保持溝通，共同為中美關係這艘大船領航掌舵。今年5月，我和川普總統一致決定構建中美建設性戰略穩定關係。這一新定位反映了中美關係的現實，也體現了對未來的期許，是邁向兩國正確相處之道的重要一步。我們要把這一願景轉化為行動，朝著合作為主、競爭有度、分歧可控、和平可期的方向努力，走出一條兩個大國的正確相處之道。中美兩國應當也完全可以在務實合作中互利共贏，在良性競爭中彼此成就，在求同存異中妥處分歧，在累積互信中構築和平，讓中美建設性戰略穩定關係更好惠及兩國人民和世界各國人民。
習近平強調，雙方經貿團隊舉行新一輪磋商，達成了一份新的聯合安排，對兩國產業界、老百姓乃至全球經濟都是好消息。合作是雙行道，中美經貿關係的穩定既需要拉長合作清單，也需要壓縮問題清單。只要秉持平等、尊重、互惠的精神，就能找到解決問題的出路。希望雙方相向而行，堅持互利共贏導向，推動中美經貿關係持續穩定向好發展。
習近平指出，中美都是人工智能大國，雙方有競爭，更可以合作，應該各展所長而不是相互設防。雙方可以繼續開展人工智能對話，就其風險和收益進行交流，共同防範人工智能被濫用惡用。要保持人類對人工智能技術的管控，秉持以人為本、向上向善理念，讓人工智能為人類的進步服務。
習近平強調，中方維護國家統一和領土完整的立場是很清楚的。希望美方堅持反對「台獨」的正確立場，慎重處理台灣問題，為中美戰略合作和兩國關係發展奠定堅實基礎。
川普表示，習近平主席這次對美國的國事訪問是一次偉大的訪問。美中都是大國，我同習近平主席是好朋友，保持著深入密切溝通。在我們的領導下，美中關係一定能搞好。兩國經貿團隊舉行新一輪磋商取得新的成果，雙方要繼續對話，達成更好的協議。人工智能關乎人類未來，美中應就此保持對話，加強合作。
兩國元首還就中東局勢、烏克蘭危機、朝鮮半島等重大國際和地區問題交換了意見。
兩國元首確認將相互支持辦好2026年亞太經合組織領導人非正式會議和二十國集團領導人峰會。
paras_en: U.S. and Chinese heads of state met for the second time this year. According to China’s state news agency Xinhua, Chinese President Xi Jinping met President Donald Trump at the White House on Thursday (the 24th), stressing the need to “maintain national unity” and “territorial integrity,” urging the U.S. to persist in opposing Taiwan independence and to handle the Taiwan issue with caution. The two powers also discussed continuing dialogue on artificial intelligence (AI) development, noting that while competition exists, “cooperation is also possible.”
The following is Xinhua’s official news release:

Xi said that the reciprocal visits by the heads of the United States and China within less than six months are unprecedented in the history of bilateral relations. He noted that he and President Trump have kept in touch through various channels and are jointly steering the “big ship” of U.S.–China relations. In May, the two leaders agreed to build a constructive, strategically stable U.S.–China relationship. This new positioning reflects the reality of the relationship and embodies expectations for the future, marking an important step toward a proper way for the two great powers to get along. Xi said the vision must be turned into action, aiming for a path characterized by cooperation as the mainstay, moderate competition, controllable differences, and hopeful peace, thereby forging a correct mode of interaction between the two powers. He added that the two countries can achieve mutual benefit and win‑win outcomes through pragmatic cooperation, achieve mutual advancement in healthy competition, manage differences by seeking common ground while reserving differences, and build peace by accumulating trust, so that a constructive, strategically stable U.S.–China relationship better serves the peoples of both nations and the world.

Xi emphasized that the new round of trade‑team talks produced a fresh joint arrangement, which is good news for the industries, the public in both countries, and the global economy. He said cooperation is a two‑way street; stability in U.S.–China economic ties requires both expanding the list of cooperative items and shrinking the list of problem items. As long as the principles of equality, respect and reciprocity are upheld, solutions can be found. He expressed hope that both sides will move forward together, adhere to a win‑win orientation, and promote the continued stable and positive development of bilateral economic and trade relations.

Xi pointed out that both China and the United States are major AI powers. While there is competition, there is also room for cooperation, and each side should play to its strengths rather than set up defenses against the other. He said the two sides can continue AI dialogue, exchange views on risks and benefits, and jointly prevent the misuse of AI. He called for humanity to retain control over AI technology, guided by a people‑centered, upward‑and‑good ethos, so that AI serves human progress.

Xi stressed that China’s stance on safeguarding national unity and territorial integrity is crystal clear. He urged the U.S. to maintain the correct position of opposing “Taiwan independence,” to handle the Taiwan issue prudently, and to lay a solid foundation for strategic cooperation and the development of bilateral relations.

Trump said that President Xi’s state visit to the United States is a great visit. Both nations are great powers, and he described Xi as a good friend with whom he maintains deep and close communication. Under their leadership, U.S.–China relations can certainly be improved. The new round of trade‑team talks has yielded fresh results, and both sides should keep dialogue going to reach better agreements. AI concerns humanity’s future, and the United States and China should keep talking on the issue and strengthen cooperation.
The two leaders also exchanged views on major international and regional issues, including the Middle‑East situation, the Ukraine crisis, and the Korean Peninsula.
The heads of state confirmed that they will support each other in successfully hosting the 2026 APEC Leaders’ Informal Meeting and the G20 Leaders’ Summit.

items.title: 戴爾高層狂賣股 AI漲勢加速下套現3200萬美元
items.title_en: Dell Executives Frenzied Share Sell-Off, Cashing $32 Million Amid Accelerating AI Rally
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)近期面臨一波內部人士賣股潮，包括財務長與法務長在內的高階主管，紛紛在公開市場進行數百萬美元規模的股票交易。
美國證券管理委員會(SEC)近期申報文件顯示，戴爾兩名高階主管9月17日合計出售超過1,500萬美元的公司股票。財務長David Kennedy出售23,896股，套現約1,350萬美元，成交價格介於每股584.73至586.08美元。法務長Richard Rothberg則出售4,000股，套現230萬美元，平均每股583.36美元。
內部人士賣股其實從本月初就已開始。9月4日，人資長Jennifer Saavedra以每股520美元出售25,251股，套現1,310萬美元。同日，行銷長Geraldine Tunnell以每股523.52美元出售5,436股，套現280萬美元。
四名高階主管本月合計出售約3,170萬美元的公司股票。這些交易占戴爾超過3.15億股流通股的比例不到1%。
戴爾股價本月初以來已大漲逾17%，漲幅超越那斯達克100指數與標普500指數。這兩大指數——戴爾均為成分股——同期分別上漲3.5%與0.4%。
自1984年成立以來，戴爾已從一家新創個人電腦製造商，逐漸轉型為人工智慧熱潮的重要受惠者，成為關鍵基礎設施供應商。
9月2日公布的財報進一步證明公司動能強勁。戴爾AI伺服器業務帶來的營收較去年同期翻倍。戴爾的積壓訂單也大幅增加，從513億美元攀升至950億美元。
《巴隆》在5月底將戴爾列為推薦股票，延續2025年10月的投資建議。自最新推薦以來，戴爾股價已上漲約27%。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Dell Technologies (DELL-US) has recently faced a wave of insider stock sales, with senior executives including the CFO and CLO conducting multi‑million‑dollar transactions in the open market.

SEC filings show that on September 17 two Dell senior executives sold more than $15 million worth of company stock in total. CFO David Kennedy sold 23,896 shares, netting about $13.5 million at prices between $584.73 and $586.08 per share. CLO Richard Rothberg sold 4,000 shares, netting $2.3 million at an average of $583.36 per share.

Insider selling actually began earlier this month. On September 4, HR chief Jennifer Saavedra sold 25,251 shares at $520 each, raising $13.1 million. The same day, marketing chief Geraldine Tunnell sold 5,436 shares at $523.52 each, raising $2.8 million.
The four senior executives sold roughly $31.7 million of Dell stock this month. The transactions represent less than 1 % of Dell’s float of about 315 million shares.

Dell’s share price has surged more than 17 % since the start of the month, outpacing both the Nasdaq‑100 and the S&P 500. The two indices—of which Dell is a component—rose 3.5 % and 0.4 % respectively over the same period.
Since its founding in 1984, Dell has evolved from a startup personal‑computer maker into a major beneficiary of the AI boom, becoming a key provider of core infrastructure.

The earnings report released on September 2 further confirmed the company’s strong momentum. Revenue from Dell’s AI server business doubled year‑over‑year, and its backlog of orders jumped from $51.3 billion to $95.0 billion.
Baron listed Dell as a recommended stock at the end of May, extending its investment thesis through October 2025. Since the latest recommendation, Dell’s share price has risen about 27 %.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉油價上漲、Fed升息疑慮壟罩 黃金觸及一周低點
items.title_en: Precious Metals After‑Hours: Oil Prices Rise, Fed Rate‑Hike Concerns Loom, Gold Hits One‑Week Low
paras: 黃金周四(24日)下跌至一周低點，油價上漲加上聯準會(Fed)措辭轉鷹，強化了升息前景，也打壓不孳息的黃金。

黃金現貨下跌0.5%，報每盎司4265.50美元，盤中一度觸及9月16日以來最低。
美國黃金期貨收低0.5%，報每盎司4298美元。


High Ridge Futures金屬交易主管David Meger說：「黃金持續受到能源價格上漲與利率走高的壓力……能源價格上漲將加劇市場對通膨的疑慮，也提高聯準會(Fed)進一步升息的可能性。」
油價周四上漲約2%，沙烏地阿拉伯遭胡塞武裝組織飛彈攻擊後，市場重新擔心供應可能中斷。
能源價格上漲可能推升整體通膨，因製造商會將較高的成本轉嫁給消費者，進而迫使各國央行採取更緊縮的貨幣政策，以抑制物價。
Fed上周啟動三年來首度升息，並釋出今年將進一步升息的訊號。數名Fed官員接連強調需要進一步升息，最新一位是Fed理事巴爾(Michael Barr)，他也表示有必要採取更緊縮的貨幣政策。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期Fed 10月升息的機率為69%。黃金雖是傳統的抗通膨資產，但利率走高將削弱其吸引力。
美元也對金價構成壓力，美元指數升至兩個月高點，使以美元計價的黃金對海外買家而言更加昂貴。同時，美國10年期公債殖利率徘徊在近20年高點附近，提高持有黃金這類不孳息資產的機會成本。
Saxo Bank大宗商品策略主管Ole Hansen在報告中說：「黃金近期約4235美元的支撐低點是頭一個值得關注的價位。若跌破該水準，市場可能面臨更深的修正，並可能重新關注6月至7月約4000美元附近的價位。」

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌1.3%，報每盎司63.60美元。
現貨白金下跌0.1%，報每盎司1748.46美元。
現貨鈀金上漲0.7%，報每盎司1268.24美元。
paras_en: Gold fell to a one‑week low on Thursday (the 24th) as higher oil prices and a more hawkish tone from the Federal Reserve reinforced expectations of further rate hikes, weighing on the non‑yielding metal.

Spot gold slipped 0.5% to $4,265.50 per ounce, briefly touching its lowest level since September 16. U.S. gold futures also fell 0.5% to $4,298 per ounce. David Meger, head of metals trading at High Ridge Futures, said: “Gold continues to feel pressure from rising energy prices and higher interest rates… Higher energy costs will heighten market inflation concerns and increase the likelihood of further Fed rate hikes.”
Oil prices rose about 2% on Thursday after Saudi Arabia was hit by a missile attack from Houthi forces, reviving worries that supply could be disrupted.
Higher energy prices could push overall inflation higher as manufacturers pass increased costs onto consumers, forcing central banks worldwide to adopt tighter monetary policies to curb price growth.

The Fed initiated its first rate hike in three years last week and signaled that further increases are likely this year. Several Fed officials have repeatedly stressed the need for additional tightening, most recently Fed Governor Michael Barr, who said more restrictive policy is necessary.
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders now assign a 69% probability to a Fed rate hike in October. Although gold is traditionally seen as an inflation hedge, rising rates diminish its appeal.

A stronger dollar also pressured gold, with the dollar index climbing to a two‑month high, making gold priced in dollars more expensive for overseas buyers. At the same time, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield hovered near a 20‑year peak, raising the opportunity cost of holding non‑yielding assets like gold.

Ole Hansen, head of commodities strategy at Saxo Bank, wrote in a report: “The roughly $4,235 support level that gold has been testing recently is the first price point to watch. If it breaks below that, the market could face a deeper correction and may refocus on the $4,000‑ish area seen in June‑July.”
Other precious‑metal prices: Spot silver fell 1.3% to $63.60 per ounce. Spot platinum slipped 0.1% to $1,748.46 per ounce. Spot palladium rose 0.7% to $1,268.24 per ounce.

items.title: 貝佐斯砸錢25年320億美元仍不夠？藍色起源首度引入外部資金100億美元
items.title_en: Is $32 B Over 25 Years Still Not Enough for Bezos? Blue Origin Secures First $10 B of External Funding
paras: 藍色起源(Blue Origin)正從長期由創辦人傑夫・貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)個人資金支持的太空事業，逐步轉向引入外部資本。據《華爾街日報》報導，藍色起源目前已籌得約100億美元的新資金，貝佐斯自2000年創立公司以來對藍色起源的累計投入也已達約320億美元。
這輪融資是藍色起源成立以來首次向外部投資人募資，先前市場消息顯示，公司原本以約1300億美元的投前估值尋求募集100億美元；最新報導則指出，隨著融資進展，公司目前估值約達1400億美元。這意味著藍色起源在經過長達25年的創辦人自掏腰包投入後，開始透過機構資金擴大發展所需的財務基礎。
此次融資中，貝佐斯本人將再投入20億美元，其他資金則來自外部投資人。此前相關報導指出，資產管理公司Coatue Management預計投入約40億美元，其餘約40億美元則由其他機構投資人提供。這項資本結構也顯示，藍色起源正試圖降低過去高度依賴貝佐斯個人財富的模式。
貝佐斯過去主要透過出售亞馬遜(Amazon.com, AMZN-US)股票取得資金，再投入藍色起源。累計投入320億美元的規模，反映這家太空公司的長期研發、基礎設施建設及火箭開發需要龐大資本支撐。藍色起源自2000年成立以來，一直由貝佐斯維持高度控制，直到此次交易才正式向外部資金敞開大門。
在引進新資金之際，藍色起源執行長戴夫・林普(Dave Limp)也正在重新調整公司營運方向。公司目前約有1.5萬名員工，管理層正推動針對性的裁員與組織重整，將資源集中於核心技術、軌道級火箭及NASA合約等業務，同時暫停部分受到外界關注的次軌道太空旅遊飛行。
藍色起源近年的核心任務之一，是提高New Glenn重型可重複使用火箭的生產與發射能力。New Glenn被視為公司進軍商業及政府衛星發射市場的關鍵產品，並將與SpaceX等業者競爭。公司同時也在發展月球登陸器及其他太空基礎設施，尋求從單純的火箭發射業務進一步拓展至更完整的太空產業鏈。
藍色起源今年5月曾遭遇重大挫折，New Glenn火箭在佛羅里達州發射台發生爆炸，造成發射設施受損，公司因而需要進行重建與調整。不過，在事故發生前，New Glenn已完成兩次可重複使用火箭的發射及回收，顯示公司仍持續累積軌道級火箭的操作能力。
除發射業務外，藍色起源也在布局太空資料中心及月球任務。公司今年1月公布TeraWave計畫，提出建立軌道資料中心及相關太空基礎設施的構想；同時，公司已取得NASA月球任務相關合約，涵蓋載送太空人及月球車等任務，未來數年可能成為公司營收及資本支出的重要來源。
營收方面，藍色起源2025年營收約為8億美元，公司預計2026年將增至14億美元，並在2030年以前進一步擴大至每年超過300億美元。若這項目標最終實現，代表公司未來數年需要大幅提高火箭發射頻率、生產能力及太空相關業務的商業化程度。
此次引入外部資本，也凸顯商業太空產業競爭正進入資本密集階段。SpaceX近期完成上市並取得大規模資金，使商業太空產業的資本規模進一步提升；藍色起源則在成立逾25年後首次引進外部投資人，希望透過新資金加快火箭、月球任務及太空基礎設施等項目的推進。
對貝佐斯而言，此次交易意味著藍色起源的資金來源開始從單一創辦人投入，轉向由創辦人與機構投資人共同支撐。隨著公司估值升至約1400億美元、外部資金達100億美元，加上2030年營收超過300億美元的目標，藍色起源正進入與過去25年不同的新階段，未來能否將龐大的資本投入轉化為更高的發射頻率、NASA任務及商業收入，將成為公司下一階段的重要課題。
paras_en: Blue Origin is gradually shifting its space venture, which has long been funded by founder Jeff Bezos' personal wealth, toward bringing in external capital. According to the Wall Street Journal, Blue Origin has now raised about $10 billion in new funds, while Bezos' cumulative investment since founding the company in 2000 has reached roughly $32 billion.

This financing round marks the first time Blue Origin has sought money from outside investors since its inception. Earlier market reports indicated the company was seeking to raise $10 billion at a pre‑money valuation of about $130 billion; the latest report says that as the deal progresses the company’s valuation is now around $140 billion. This means that after 25 years of the founder’s own cash injections, Blue Origin is beginning to expand its financial base with institutional money.

In this round, Bezos himself will contribute another $2 billion, with the remaining capital coming from external investors. Prior reports said asset‑management firm Coatue Management is expected to put in roughly $4 billion, and about $4 billion will come from other institutional investors. This capital structure shows Blue Origin is trying to reduce its past heavy reliance on Bezos’ personal fortune.

Bezos has historically funded Blue Origin by selling shares of Amazon.com (AMZN‑US) and directing the proceeds to the space company. The cumulative $32 billion investment reflects the massive capital needed for long‑term R&D, infrastructure building, and rocket development. Since its founding in 2000, Blue Origin has been tightly controlled by Bezos, and only with this transaction does it formally open its doors to outside money.

As the new capital arrives, CEO Dave Limp is also reshaping the company’s operating direction. With roughly 15,000 employees, management is pushing targeted layoffs and organizational restructuring, concentrating resources on core technologies, orbital‑class rockets, and NASA contracts, while pausing some sub‑orbital tourism flights that have drawn public attention.

One of Blue Origin’s recent core missions is to increase production and launch capability of the New Glenn heavy reusable rocket. New Glenn is seen as the key product for the company’s push into commercial and government satellite launch markets and will compete with firms such as SpaceX. The company is also developing lunar landers and other space infrastructure, seeking to move beyond pure launch services toward a fuller space industry value chain.

In May of this year, Blue Origin suffered a major setback when a New Glenn rocket exploded on a Florida launch pad, damaging the facility and forcing a rebuild and redesign. However, before the accident New Glenn had already completed two successful reusable rocket launches and recoveries, showing the company is still building orbital‑class operational capability.

Beyond launch services, Blue Origin is also positioning itself in space data centers and lunar missions. In January, the company announced the TeraWave project, proposing an orbital data center and related space infrastructure; it has also secured NASA lunar‑mission contracts covering crew and rover transport, which could become a significant source of revenue and capital spending in the coming years.

Revenue‑wise, Blue Origin posted about $800 million in 2025 and expects to grow to $1.4 billion in 2026, with a goal of exceeding $30 billion annually before 2030. If that target is achieved, the company will need to dramatically increase launch frequency, production capacity, and the commercialisation of its space‑related businesses in the coming years.

The influx of external capital also highlights that competition in the commercial space sector is entering a capital‑intensive phase. SpaceX’s recent public listing and large funding round have further raised the industry’s capital ceiling; Blue Origin, after more than 25 years, is now bringing in outside investors for the first time, hoping new money will accelerate rockets, lunar missions, and space‑infrastructure projects.

For Bezos, the deal means Blue Origin’s funding source is shifting from a single founder’s contribution to a mix of founder and institutional investors. With the company now valued at roughly $140 billion, $10 billion of external capital secured, and a goal of over $30 billion in revenue by 2030, Blue Origin is entering a new phase distinct from the past 25 years. Whether it can turn the massive capital input into higher launch rates, more NASA contracts, and greater commercial revenue will be the key challenge ahead.

items.title: Fed接連「放鷹」美債賣壓延燒全球 30年期升破5.5% 觸2004年新高
items.title_en: Fed's Continued Hawkish Stance Fuels Global Treasury Sell‑off; 30‑Year Yield Breaks 5.5% to Reach 2004 High
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 官員接連釋出可能繼續升息的訊號，美債週四 (24 日) 延續前一日跌勢，全球債市也同步承壓。30 年期美債殖利率盤中一度升至 5.5016%，創 2004 年 6 月以來新高；10 年期殖利率最高觸及 5.2251%，寫下 19 年新高。
兩項殖利率隨後自高點回落，但仍較前一日上升。30 年期美債殖利率稍晚上升 7 個基點至 5.472%，10 年期上升 7.1 個基點至 5.185%。
7 年期殖利率上升 8 個基點至 5.133%，對 Fed 利率預期較敏感的 2 年期殖利率上升 1.9 個基點至 4.914%，2 年期與 10 年期美債殖利率利差為正 26.9 個基點。
Fed 上週才進行 2023 年以來首次升息，而近期市場正在提高對 Fed 再次升息的押注。
根據芝商所 (CME Group) FedWatch 數據顯示，交易員預估 Fed 在 10 月會議升息的機率約為 70%，高於週三稍晚的 66%。
Fed 官員談話是預期轉變的原因之一。Fed 理事巴爾週三表示，為使通膨回到目標，未來可能需要進一步調整政策。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯週四在倫敦指出，預期今年底前再升息是「合理的」；費城聯準銀行總裁鮑爾森也表示，可能需要進一步升息以壓低通膨。
這波賣壓從週三加劇。當天公布的美國採購經理人指數 (PMI) 優於預期，重新引發市場對通膨的疑慮，交易員隨之提高升息押注；5 年期美債標售需求疲弱，進一步推高殖利率。10 年期美債殖利率週三創下 2025 年 4 月 7 日以來最大單日升幅。
週四的 7 年期美債標售未能明顯緩解壓力。One Point BFG Wealth Partners 投資長 Peter Boockvar 指出，這次標售的投標倍數低於過去 12 個月平均，表現偏弱，但沒有週三的 5 年期標售那麼差。
美國財政部同日透過既有回購計畫，買回 40.78 億美元的 20 至 30 年期公債；此次供出售的債券總額為 104.68 億美元。財政部稍早表示，最多將買回 60 億美元，目的在於支持市場流動性。回購結果公布後，30 年期殖利率漲幅略為擴大。
債市也持續承受能源價格壓力。美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事推高能源價格之際，經濟成長仍具韌性；油價週四再度上漲，反映中東戰事的不確定性。
Wealthspire Advisors 資深副總裁 Oliver Pursche 表示，即使 Fed 再升息 1 碼、甚至 2 碼，政策利率的調整幅度仍落後於市場利率升幅。他認為，市場最在意的是高能源價格造成的通膨壓力，以及能源價格何時能回落。
Madison Investments 固定收益主管 Mike Sanders 則指出，財政、經濟、地緣政治及供給端的通膨壓力同時浮現，近期殖利率上升已不能單以財政赤字疑慮解釋。他表示，市場目前反映未來至明年可能升息 4 次，但 Fed 若持續收緊政策，政策失誤風險也將上升。
債市賣壓並不限於美國。日本 10 年期公債殖利率週四上升 10 個基點至 3.075%，創 1996 年 8 月以來新高；5 年期殖利率也上升 10 個基點至 2.375%，創歷史新高。20 年期與 30 年期殖利率分別上升 8 個及 6 個基點，至 3.900% 和 4.130%。
歐洲債市同樣承壓，德國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 1.5 個基點至 3.549%，英國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 2.1 個基點至 5.340%。
paras_en: Fed officials kept signaling that further rate hikes may be possible, and U.S. Treasury bonds on Thursday continued the decline seen the day before, putting pressure on global bond markets as well. The 30‑year Treasury yield rose intraday to 5.5016%, a new high since June 2004; the 10‑year yield peaked at 5.2251%, a 19‑year high.
Both yields later fell from those peaks but remained higher than the previous day. The 30‑year Treasury yield rose another 7 basis points to 5.472%, and the 10‑year rose 7.1 basis points to 5.185%.
The 7‑year yield climbed 8 basis points to 5.133%, while the Fed‑sensitive 2‑year yield rose 1.9 basis points to 4.914%, leaving the 2‑year/10‑year spread positive at 26.9 basis points.
The Fed had its first rate hike since 2023 just last week, and markets are now increasing bets on another hike.
CME Group’s FedWatch data shows traders estimate roughly a 70% probability of a rate hike at the October meeting, up from about 66% late Wednesday.

Fed officials’ remarks are one reason for the shift. Fed Governor Barr said on Wednesday that further policy adjustments may be needed to bring inflation back to target. New York Fed President Williams said in London on Thursday that another hike before year‑end is “reasonable”; Philadelphia Fed President Bowman also said further hikes may be needed to curb inflation.

The selling pressure intensified on Wednesday. That day’s U.S. Purchasing Managers’ Index came in better than expected, reviving inflation concerns and prompting traders to raise rate‑hike bets; demand for the 5‑year Treasury auction was weak, pushing yields higher. The 10‑year yield on Wednesday posted its biggest single‑day rise since April 7 2025.

Thursday’s 7‑year Treasury auction failed to noticeably ease pressure. Peter Boockvar, CIO of One Point BFG Wealth Partners, noted the bid‑to‑cover ratio was below the 12‑month average, indicating weak demand, though not as poor as Wednesday’s 5‑year auction.

The Treasury on the same day bought back $4.078 billion of 20‑ to 30‑year bonds through its existing repo program; the total amount offered for sale was $10.468 billion. Earlier the Treasury said it could buy back up to $6 billion to support market liquidity. After the repo results were released, the 30‑year yield’s rise modestly widened.

Bond markets also remain under pressure from energy prices. While the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran has pushed energy prices higher, economic growth remains resilient; oil prices rose again on Thursday, reflecting uncertainty over the Middle‑East conflict.

Oliver Pursche, senior vice president at Wealthspire Advisors, said that even if the Fed hikes another 0.25 or even 0.5 percentage point, the adjustment in policy rates will still lag behind market rate moves. He believes the market is most concerned about inflation pressure from high energy prices and when those prices will fall.

Mike Sanders, head of fixed income at Madison Investments, pointed out that fiscal, economic, geopolitical and supply‑side inflation pressures are all emerging, and recent yield rises can no longer be explained solely by fiscal‑deficit worries. He said the market currently prices in up to four hikes through next year, but if the Fed keeps tightening, the risk of policy error will rise.

The sell‑off is not limited to the United States. Japan’s 10‑year government bond yield rose 10 basis points on Thursday to 3.075%, a high not seen since August 1996; the 5‑year yield also rose 10 basis points to 2.375%, a record high. The 20‑year and 30‑year yields rose 8 and 6 basis points to 3.900% and 4.130% respectively.
European bond markets are also under pressure, with Germany’s 10‑year yield up 1.5 basis points to 3.549% and the UK’s 10‑year yield up 2.1 basis points to 5.340%.

items.title: 甲骨文重挫3.5%「不可抗力」通知讓AI多頭感到不安？
items.title_en: Oracle Slides 3.5% as ‘Force Majeure’ Notice Raises AI Bull Concerns
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)已在AI生態系各個環節布局，而一項新的變數可能為整個產業帶來問題。
這家科技巨頭已針對位於新墨西哥州唐納安那(Doña Ana)郡、名為Project Jupiter的2.45GW資料中心項目發出「不可抗力」通知。
該項目與OpenAI及軟銀(SoftBank)(SFTBY-US)共同推動的「星際之門」(Stargate)計畫有關，OpenAI是客戶。據悉，這份通知已發送給項目的開發商、私人信貸業者Blue Owl Capital，目的是在Project Jupiter無法於2028年啟用運作的情況下，延後付款。
甲骨文副總裁Michael Egbert在聲明中表示，「Project Jupiter仍按照我們原訂的時程推進。我們完全致力於在新墨西哥州推動這項計畫，並對未來的發展方向充滿信心。對於如此大規模的開發案而言，不可抗力通知很常見，通常是項目合作夥伴用來保留合約權利的方式。通知本身並不代表專案出現延遲，也不代表交付預期有所改變。」
甲骨文股價周四因這項消息重挫3.5%。這項發展也為AI產業蒙上陰影，帶動輝達(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)與美光(MU-US)同步走低。
KeyBanc分析師Jackson Ader表示，「在所有主要超大規模雲端服務商中，甲骨文的現金狀況最為吃緊。這類問題可能蔓延開來，但相較於現金更充裕的大型同業，甲骨文感受到的衝擊確實更為直接。」
市場真正擔心的是問題可能擴散。甲骨文已簽署數十項協議，並承擔龐大債務來支應其人工智慧布局。任何對其精心打造的AI版圖造成的干擾，都可能讓甲骨文面臨更大的財務壓力，而這也意味著AI產業中的其他企業可能受到波及。
Ader進一步表示，「透過租賃資料中心並取得第三方融資，有時項目的現金付款時程可能與實際項目進度並不一致。這似乎就是目前發生的情況。付款可能按照時間表到期，但營收何時產生，則取決於現實世界中複雜的物流與建設進度。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Oracle (ORCL-US) has been positioning itself across all layers of the AI ecosystem, and a new variable could pose problems for the entire industry.
The tech giant has issued a ‘force majeure’ notice for its 2.45 GW Project Jupiter data‑center in Doña Ana County, New Mexico.

The project is tied to the ‘Stargate’ initiative jointly driven by OpenAI and SoftBank (SFTBY-US), with OpenAI as a customer. The notice was sent to the developer and private‑credit provider Blue Owl Capital to defer payments if Project Jupiter cannot be operational by 2028.

Oracle Vice President Michael Egbert said in a statement, “Project Jupiter remains on schedule as originally planned. We are fully committed to advancing this project in New Mexico and are confident about its future direction. For a development of this scale, force‑majeure notices are common and are typically used by project partners to preserve contractual rights. The notice itself does not indicate a delay nor a change to delivery expectations.”
Oracle’s shares fell 3.5% on Thursday after the news, casting a shadow over the AI sector and pulling down Nvidia (NVDA-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Micron (MU-US) as well.

KeyBanc analyst Jackson Ader said, “Among the major hyperscale cloud providers, Oracle’s cash position is the tightest. This type of issue could spread, and compared with better‑capitalized peers, Oracle feels a more direct impact.”

The market’s real worry is the potential for contagion. Oracle has signed dozens of agreements and taken on substantial debt to fund its AI push. Any disruption to its carefully built AI roadmap could increase financial pressure on Oracle and ripple through other AI‑related companies.

Ader added, “When data‑centers are leased and third‑party financing is used, the cash‑payment schedule can diverge from actual project progress. That appears to be what’s happening now. Payments may come due on a timetable, but revenue generation depends on the complex logistics and construction timeline in the real world.”

items.title: OpenAI高層再流動！前數據中心主管轉投輝達 出任DSX平台副總裁
items.title_en: OpenAI Executive Moves Again: Former Data Center Head Joins Nvidia as DSX Platform Vice President
paras: OpenAI前數據中心主管Chris Malone本月加入輝達(NVDA-US), 出任DSX Platform副總裁, 負責協助客戶依照輝達的架構與規格設計、建造人工智慧數據中心。Malone今年8月才離開OpenAI, 如今轉往AI晶片龍頭, 正值大型AI公司持續擴大數據中心投資之際, 也凸顯數據中心基礎設施人才的重要性持續升高。
根據Malone的LinkedIn資料, 他已於本月加入輝達並擔任DSX Platform副總裁。DSX是輝達近年推動AI Factory概念的重要平台, 目標是將GPU、CPU、網路設備、軟體及數據中心基礎設施整合, 協助客戶更快建置能夠支援大規模AI運算的完整系統。
Malone於2025年3月加入OpenAI擔任數據中心主管, 時間點恰好落在Stargate計畫宣布後不久。Stargate是OpenAI與Oracle(ORCL-US)、SoftBank Group合作推動的大型AI基礎設施計畫, 目標是建立大規模數據中心以滿足OpenAI快速成長的運算需求。Malone在OpenAI任職約17個月後於今年8月離開公司。
在加入OpenAI之前, Malone曾負責Meta Platforms(META-US)及Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)相關數據中心基礎設施工作, 因此累積了大型科技公司在數據中心設計、建設及運營方面的經驗。此次轉投輝達, 也讓他再次回到AI基礎設施產業核心。
Malone離開OpenAI之際, 公司正經歷一系列高階主管異動。OpenAI在8月表示, 公司近期重新調整基礎設施組織, 以因應工作規模及速度的變化, 並指出目前擁有經驗豐富的數據中心團隊, 具備執行相關計畫所需的技術能力。
OpenAI近年對運算基礎設施的需求急速增加, 數據中心已成為公司擴大模型訓練及提供AI服務的核心。2025年9月, OpenAI與輝達宣布策略合作, 計畫部署至少10GW的輝達AI系統, 涵蓋數百萬顆GPU。輝達當時表示, 計畫將隨每GW部署逐步提供最高1,000億美元的投資支持, 首個1GW部署目標為2026年下半年。
最新的Ohio大型數據中心計畫進一步顯示雙方合作規模。8月17日, 輝達宣布將與SB Energy合作, 取得Ohio州PORTS-Pike Technology Campus的土地、電力及建築容量, 並成為該園區AI運算基礎設施的獨家供應商。OpenAI則是該園區客戶, 預計使用約8GW的IT運算容量。
該Ohio計畫的初始部署規模為4.25GW IT容量, 輝達另擁有將容量擴大3.75GW的選擇權。輝達將投資15億美元於SB Energy, 同時為土地、電力及建築外殼等初始4.25GW建設提供信用支持。SB Energy將負責建造、擁有及營運數據中心, 並以20年租約提供容量給OpenAI。
OpenAI則表示, PORTS-Pike整體規模約8GW IT容量, 首批800MW預計2028年投入使用, 其中大部分將利用現有AEP電力基礎設施。後續開發則需要新增天然氣發電設施、輸電線路及其他電力基礎建設。OpenAI預估, 該計畫在截至2032年的6年建設期間可創造約3.5萬個建築工作職位, 長期營運則可創造約2,500個工作職位。
在這項合作架構下, SB Energy負責數據中心建設及營運, OpenAI承擔長期使用容量的角色, 而輝達則提供AI運算硬體及完整AI Factory架構。PORTS-Pike將使用輝達包括GPU、CPU及網路設備在內的全套DSX AI Factory平台, 反映輝達正從單純AI晶片供應商進一步向完整數據中心基礎設施平台供應商延伸。
輝達表示, DSX AI Factory架構將把設施、硬體與軟體整合在同一套系統中, 目標是降低基礎設施管理負擔, 並縮短從數據中心建設到實際產生AI運算能力的時間。對OpenAI等大型AI模型開發商而言, 數據中心建設速度及可取得的運算容量已成為影響模型訓練及AI服務擴張的重要因素。
此次人事變動也發生在AI數據中心投資規模快速擴張之際。Investing.com報導指出, 8月輝達同意為SB Energy在Ohio興建的10GW數據中心提供1,050億美元信用支持, OpenAI將租用該設施, 並計畫以大規模輝達晶片填充數據中心。輝達8月正式公布的方案則指出, 初始4.25GW容量將獲得信用支持, 並保留另外3.75GW的擴充選擇權。
OpenAI與輝達之間的合作也不僅限於硬體採購。雙方此前已表示, 將共同優化OpenAI的模型與基礎設施軟體, 以及輝達的硬體與軟體產品路線。PORTS-Pike計畫則將進一步由雙方共同進行設計、測試及啟用工作, 並計畫發布技術白皮書, 分享大規模AI運算中心在韌性設計、設備驗證及軟體層工作負載管理方面的經驗。
從人才布局來看, Malone熟悉Meta、Google及OpenAI等大型AI及科技公司的數據中心運作, 此次加入輝達後負責DSX平台, 正好與輝達近年擴大AI Factory業務的方向重疊。隨著AI模型訓練及推理需求持續增加, 數據中心不再只是提供機房與電力的基礎設施, 而是逐漸成為GPU、CPU、高速網路、儲存、電力及軟體共同運作的完整AI系統。
對OpenAI而言, Malone的離開並未改變公司持續擴大數據中心容量的策略。OpenAI今年8月與SB Energy及輝達合作推動PORTS-Pike, 並表示將依照自身長期前沿模型訓練及產品需求使用相關容量, 同時只會在完成的容量可以投入租賃後開始支付費用。
對輝達而言, DSX平台則是其AI基礎設施策略的重要組成部分。隨著大型AI公司、雲端服務商及新興AI數據中心業者投入數百億美元甚至更大規模的基礎設施建設, 輝達若能把GPU、CPU、網路設備及軟體整合為完整AI Factory方案, 將可直接參與更大範圍的數據中心建設價值鏈。
因此, Malone此次轉投輝達不僅是一項高階人才異動, 也發生在AI產業從單純爭奪模型能力, 進一步轉向爭奪運算資源、電力及數據中心建設能力的階段。OpenAI持續擴大數據中心容量, 輝達則同步把DSX平台推向大型AI工廠建設, 雙方既是重要合作夥伴, 也是AI基礎設施價值鏈中高度緊密連結的兩家公司。
paras_en: OpenAI former data center head Chris Malone joined Nvidia (NVDA-US) this month as Vice President of the DSX Platform, responsible for helping customers design and build AI data centers according to Nvidia’s architecture and specifications. Malone left OpenAI in August of this year, and his move to the AI‑chip leader comes as large AI firms continue to expand data‑center investments, underscoring the rising importance of data‑center infrastructure talent.

According to Malone’s LinkedIn profile, he joined Nvidia this month and took the role of Vice President of the DSX Platform. DSX is a key platform in Nvidia’s recent AI Factory push, aiming to integrate GPUs, CPUs, networking gear, software and data‑center infrastructure to help customers more quickly deploy complete systems that can support massive AI workloads.

Malone joined OpenAI as head of data centers in March 2025, shortly after the Stargate project was announced. Stargate is a large AI infrastructure initiative co‑led by OpenAI, Oracle (ORCL-US) and SoftBank Group, intended to build massive data centers to meet OpenAI’s rapidly growing compute needs. Malone stayed at OpenAI for about 17 months before departing in August of this year.

Before his stint at OpenAI, Malone oversaw data‑center infrastructure work for Meta Platforms (META-US) and Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL-US), gaining experience in design, construction and operation of large‑scale data centers. His move to Nvidia brings him back to the core of AI infrastructure.

Malone’s departure coincided with a wave of senior‑leadership changes at OpenAI. In August, OpenAI said it was reorganizing its infrastructure organization to match shifts in workload scale and speed, noting that it now has an experienced data‑center team with the technical capability to execute its projects.

OpenAI’s demand for compute infrastructure has surged in recent years, making data centers central to expanding model training and AI services. In September 2025, OpenAI and Nvidia announced a strategic partnership to deploy at least 10 GW of Nvidia AI systems, encompassing millions of GPUs. Nvidia said the plan would provide up to $100 billion in investment support as each gigawatt is rolled out, with the first 1 GW targeted for the second half of 2026.

The latest large‑scale data‑center project in Ohio illustrates the partnership’s scope. On August 17, Nvidia announced a collaboration with SB Energy to acquire land, power and building capacity at Ohio’s PORTS‑Pike Technology Campus, becoming the exclusive supplier of AI compute infrastructure for the site. OpenAI will be a tenant, planning to use roughly 8 GW of IT compute capacity.

The Ohio project’s initial deployment is 4.25 GW of IT capacity, with Nvidia holding an option to expand by another 3.75 GW. Nvidia will invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy and provide credit support for the land, power and building shell for the initial 4.25 GW. SB Energy will build, own and operate the data center and lease capacity to OpenAI under a 20‑year term.

OpenAI says the PORTS‑Pike campus will total about 8 GW of IT capacity, with the first 800 MW slated for use in 2028, largely leveraging existing AEP power infrastructure. Later phases will require new natural‑gas generation, transmission lines and other power upgrades. OpenAI estimates the six‑year construction period through 2032 could create roughly 35,000 construction jobs, with about 2,500 long‑term operational positions.

Under this collaboration, SB Energy handles data‑center construction and operation, OpenAI assumes the long‑term capacity user role, and Nvidia supplies AI compute hardware and the full AI Factory architecture. PORTS‑Pike will use Nvidia’s complete DSX AI Factory platform—including GPUs, CPUs and networking equipment—showcasing Nvidia’s shift from a pure AI‑chip supplier to a full data‑center infrastructure platform provider.

Nvidia says the DSX AI Factory architecture will integrate facilities, hardware and software into a single system, aiming to reduce infrastructure management burdens and shorten the time from data‑center build‑out to usable AI compute capacity. For large AI model developers like OpenAI, the speed of data‑center construction and available compute capacity are critical factors for model training and service expansion.

The personnel change comes as AI data‑center investment is rapidly expanding. Investing.com reported that in August Nvidia agreed to provide $105 billion of credit support for SB Energy’s 10 GW Ohio data‑center, which OpenAI will lease and plan to fill with massive Nvidia chips. Nvidia’s August announcement specified credit support for the initial 4.25 GW and retained an option for an additional 3.75 GW expansion.

The OpenAI‑Nvidia partnership goes beyond hardware procurement. Both parties have previously said they will jointly optimize OpenAI’s models and infrastructure software, as well as Nvidia’s hardware and software roadmaps. The PORTS‑Pike project will further involve joint design, testing and commissioning, with plans to publish a technical white paper sharing lessons on resilient design, equipment validation and software‑layer workload management for large‑scale AI compute centers.

From a talent perspective, Malone’s experience with Meta, Google and OpenAI’s data‑center operations aligns with his new responsibility for Nvidia’s DSX platform, which dovetails with Nvidia’s recent expansion of its AI Factory business. As demand for AI model training and inference grows, data centers are evolving from simple power‑and‑space providers to integrated AI systems that combine GPUs, CPUs, high‑speed networking, storage, power and software.

For OpenAI, Malone’s exit does not alter its strategy of continuously expanding data‑center capacity. In August, OpenAI partnered with SB Energy and Nvidia on the PORTS‑Pike project, stating it will use the capacity for long‑term frontier model training and product needs, and will only begin paying once the built capacity is ready for lease.

For Nvidia, the DSX platform is a core component of its AI infrastructure strategy. As large AI firms, cloud providers and emerging AI data‑center players pour hundreds of billions of dollars into infrastructure construction, Nvidia can participate across a broader value chain by bundling GPUs, CPUs, networking gear and software into a complete AI Factory solution.

Thus, Malone’s move to Nvidia is not only a senior‑talent shift but also occurs at a time when the AI industry is moving from pure model‑centric competition to a race for compute resources, power and data‑center building capability. OpenAI continues to scale data‑center capacity while Nvidia pushes the DSX platform toward large‑scale AI factory construction; the two firms remain key partners and tightly linked players in the AI infrastructure value chain.

items.title: 廣積推單板電腦整合CPU、GPU與NPU 鎖定新世代邊緣AI應用
items.title_en: Giant Integration Launches Single-Board Computer Combining CPU, GPU, and NPU for Next‑Gen Edge AI Applications
paras: 工業電腦廠廣積(8050-TW)宣布，推出高效能IB966 3.5吋單板電腦，搭載Intel Core Ultra 7系列處理器(Panther Lake平台)，於單一平台整合CPU、GPU與NPU運算資源，最高規格配置可提供達180 TOPS的整體AI運算效能，鎖定邊緣端即時AI推理、機器視覺、資料分析及工業自動化等應用場景。

廣積表示，IB966可搭載Intel Core Ultra X7 358H、Intel Core Ultra 7 356H或Intel Core Ultra 7 355處理器，透過異質運算架構依不同工作需求，將運算任務分配至合適的處理單元，加速邊緣端即時決策，同時降低延遲、網路流量及對雲端運算的依賴，並配置雙DDR5-7200 SO-DIMM插槽，最高支援128GB記憶體，可滿足資料密集型邊緣AI應用及高效多工處理需求。
在連接與擴充方面，IB966提供兩組2.5GbE、USB 3.2、USB 2.0及兩組RS232/422/485介面；顯示輸出則支援HDMI、DisplayPort、具備DisplayPort功能的USB Type-C、LVDS及eDP，並配置3個M.2插槽，可支援高速NVMe儲存及無線連線。
此外，IB966支援12V至24V直流電源輸入，並具備數位I/O、Intel AMT主動管理技術、獨立式TPM及可程式化看門狗計時器，強化系統建置的安全性、管理效率及運作可靠性，應用範圍涵蓋機器視覺、智慧製造、智慧交通、醫療影像及智慧零售等高效能邊緣AI場景。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Giant (8050‑TW) announced the high‑performance IB966 3.5‑inch single‑board computer, which uses an Intel Core Ultra 7 series processor (Panther Lake platform) to integrate CPU, GPU and NPU computing resources on a single platform. The top‑end configuration can deliver up to 180 TOPS of total AI compute, targeting edge real‑time AI inference, machine vision, data analytics and industrial automation scenarios.

Giant says the IB966 can be equipped with Intel Core Ultra X7 358H, Intel Core Ultra 7 356H or Intel Core Ultra 7 355 processors. Through a heterogeneous computing architecture, tasks are assigned to the appropriate processing unit according to workload, accelerating edge real‑time decision‑making while reducing latency, network traffic and dependence on cloud computing. The board also features dual DDR5‑7200 SO‑DIMM slots supporting up to 128 GB of memory, meeting the needs of data‑intensive edge AI and high‑efficiency multitasking.

For connectivity and expansion, the IB966 offers two 2.5 GbE ports, USB 3.2, USB 2.0 and two RS232/422/485 interfaces. Display output supports HDMI, DisplayPort, USB‑Type‑C with DisplayPort functionality, LVDS and eDP, and it includes three M.2 slots for high‑speed NVMe storage and wireless modules.

In addition, the IB966 accepts 12 V to 24 V DC power input and includes digital I/O, Intel AMT active management technology, a discrete TPM and a programmable watchdog timer, enhancing system security, management efficiency and operational reliability. Application areas cover machine vision, smart manufacturing, intelligent transportation, medical imaging and smart retail, among other high‑performance edge AI use cases.

items.title: 台鐵攜新光三越打造寶可夢列車 明起至12/13投入西部幹線營運
items.title_en: Taiwan Railways Teams Up with Shin Kong Mitsukoshi to Launch Pokémon Train, Operating on the Western Mainline from Tomorrow Until Dec 13
paras: 為推動鐵道觀光、賦予大眾運輸嶄新活力，台鐵公司今(24)日迎來跨界合作，首度攜手新光三越百貨及The Pokémon Company協助打造的「新光三越周年慶寶可夢30周年主題列車」。台鐵表示，自明(25)日起至今(2026)年12月13日，除了周六、日行駛專列外，也將投入西部幹線各都會區，並安排於各區段表定列車。
本次彩繪專列以台鐵公司EMU800型區間車進行全車包覆設計，外觀集結了歷代經典且深受各年齡層喜愛的寶可夢夥伴，車廂內部更巧妙融入精靈球及冒險元素，讓每一位旅客踏進車廂的瞬間，化身為出發冒險的「寶可夢訓練家」。
新光三越執行副總經理吳昕昌時表示，30周年真的很不容易，回憶起30年前還是中學生，每天回家看寶可夢，沒想到30年後還在追，也成為他與孩子之間重要的交流橋樑，創造許多共同回憶。
吳昕昌表示，此次三方攜手合作並非巧合而是必然，北車也是許多訓練家的「抓寶聖地」，期待大家搭上主題列車，從台北出發展開旅程。
另為配合新光三越百貨於特定期程所開行的主題專列外，此次「寶可夢列車」自明日起至12月13日止，加入台鐵常態營運編組，期間列車將每日穿梭於北、中、南部區間，串連西部路線，為方便鐵道迷與寶可夢粉絲規劃行程搭乘，台鐵將於官網及官方社群公布「寶可夢列車常態運行車次與時刻表」。
paras_en: To promote rail tourism and inject fresh vitality into public transport, Taiwan Railways Administration (TRA) announced today (the 24th) a cross‑industry partnership, debuting the “Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Anniversary Pokémon 30th‑Anniversary Themed Train” created together with Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Department Store and The Pokémon Company. TRA said that from tomorrow (the 25th) through Dec 13, 2026, in addition to special services on Saturdays and Sundays, the train will also run on the Western Mainline through various metropolitan areas and be scheduled on regular services in each segment.

The specially painted train uses TRA’s EMU‑800 series commuter cars with a full‑car wrap design, featuring classic Pokémon partners beloved by all ages. Inside, the compartments cleverly incorporate Poké Balls and adventure motifs, turning every passenger who steps aboard into a “Pokémon Trainer” ready to set off on a quest.

Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Executive Vice President Wu Hsin‑chang said the 30th anniversary is truly hard‑won. He recalled being a middle‑school student 30 years ago, watching Pokémon every day after school, and never imagined he’d still be following it three decades later. Now it serves as an important bridge for communication with his children, creating many shared memories.

Wu added that the three‑way collaboration was not a coincidence but inevitable; Taipei Main Station is also a “Pokémon‑catching hotspot” for many trainers. He looks forward to everyone hopping on the themed train and starting their journey from Taipei.

In addition to the special‑schedule runs tied to Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s promotional periods, the “Pokémon Train” will be incorporated into TRA’s regular service roster from tomorrow through Dec 13. During this period the train will travel daily across northern, central and southern segments, linking the western corridor. To help rail fans and Pokémon enthusiasts plan their trips, TRA will publish the regular‑operation train numbers and timetables on its official website and social‑media channels.

items.title: 國喬：轉型調整營運策略 鏈結AWI工業氣體布局半導體供應鏈
items.title_en: Guo Qiao: Transforming Operations Strategy and Linking AWI Industrial Gases to Semiconductor Supply Chain
paras: 面對今(2026)年高油價及全球貿易流向重塑等挑戰，國喬(1312-TW）總經理曾嘉雄今(24)日表示，除了積極調整營運策略，將轉型投資及推動產品高值化列為當前重要工作，除了持續優化本業，也積極布局高科技及半導體材料相關產業，包括今年與日本工業氣體大廠愛沃特株式會社(AWI)策略合作，將成為國喬連結半導體材料供應鏈的重要布局。
曾嘉雄指出，隨著美伊衝突持續、原油供應中斷延長，高油價抑制需求並帶動各國通膨與升息，進一步壓抑消費與企業投資動能，加上中國產能過剩持續外溢，全球產業亦加速整併與產能退出，區域供需結構有望逐步改善目前，目前石化同業也依市場需求及利差變化，彈性調整產線稼動率，以適度承接國內供應缺口。
增佳雄表示，國喬甫於上(8)月宣布攜手AWI拓展台灣半導體材料市場，共同入股特殊氣體製造商宏廣新技，看準AWI長期深耕日本工業氣體市場，產品及服務範圍多元，並持續拓展海外及電子相關事業，布局包括台灣在內的國際市場。
對雙方合作，曾嘉雄強調，合作的價值不僅為單一投資案，更在於結合國喬長期深耕台灣所累積的產業基礎，以及AWI在工業氣體、產品技術與國際市場的經驗，國喬將成為AWI在台灣重要的在地合作夥伴，雙方透過優勢互補，有望為未來在台業務拓展帶來正面效益，成為深化半導體材料市場布局的重要推進動能。
國喬長期投入高值化材料，產品涵蓋生質苯乙烯、低碳足跡氫氣、長鏈及生質基尼龍、尼龍彈性體等，子公司泉州國亨亦持續發展高熔纖維，以及應用於電子產業與汽車領域的聚丙烯產品，此次與AWI深化合作，則是在既有高值化材料布局基礎上，進一步將國際合作延伸至半導體特殊材料供應鏈，持續拓展跨產業轉型的發展空間。
國喬表示，今年上半年合併營收為129.14億元，年增17%，第2季毛利率由負轉正。公司認為，儘管石化產業仍面臨高油價、需求承壓及供給過剩等挑戰，但本業營運已有改善，未來將持續強化產品組合與營運效率，並同步推進高值化產品與策略投資布局。
曾嘉雄說，產業環境正在改變，未來競爭力不能只建立在傳統石化規模，也必須將既有製程、材料與產業經驗轉化為新的價值，未來國喬將透過國際合作與策略投資拓展高科技應用，其中產品端將深化特殊材料、電子化學品及與國內幾大氣體廠的低碳足跡氫氣合作布局，並持續評估跨域合作與全球市場發展機會，提升高值化轉型比重及長期營運韌性。
paras_en: Facing this year’s (2026) high oil prices and the reshaping of global trade flows, Guo Qiao (1312‑TW) General Manager Zeng Jia‑xiong said on the 24th that, besides actively adjusting its operating strategy, the company is prioritizing transformation investments and the up‑grading of its products. In addition to continuously optimizing its core business, it is actively positioning itself in high‑tech and semiconductor material sectors, including a strategic partnership this year with Japan’s major industrial gas firm Air Water Inc. (AWI), which will become a key part of Guo Qiao’s link to the semiconductor material supply chain.

Zeng noted that the ongoing US‑Iran conflict and prolonged disruptions in crude oil supply have pushed oil prices higher, suppressing demand and driving inflation and interest‑rate hikes worldwide. This further dampens consumer spending and corporate investment, while excess capacity in China continues to spill over abroad. Global industries are accelerating consolidation and capacity exits, and regional supply‑demand balances are expected to gradually improve. Accordingly, petrochemical peers are flexibly adjusting line utilization rates based on market demand and margin shifts to modestly fill domestic supply gaps.

Zeng added that Guo Qiao announced in August that it would partner with AWI to expand Taiwan’s semiconductor material market, jointly taking equity in specialty gas maker Hong Guang Xin Ji. The move leverages AWI’s long‑term foothold in Japan’s industrial gas market, its diversified product and service portfolio, and its ongoing expansion into overseas and electronics‑related businesses, targeting international markets including Taiwan.

Regarding the collaboration, Zeng emphasized that its value lies not only in a single investment project but also in combining Guo Qiao’s deep, long‑standing industry foundation in Taiwan with AWI’s expertise in industrial gases, product technology, and international markets. Guo Qiao will become AWI’s important local partner in Taiwan, and through complementary strengths the partnership is expected to generate positive effects for future business expansion in Taiwan and serve as a key driver for deepening the semiconductor material market presence.

Guo Qiao has long invested in high‑value materials, offering products such as bio‑based styrene, low‑carbon‑footprint hydrogen, long‑chain and bio‑based nylon, and nylon elastomers. Its subsidiary Quanzhou Guo Heng continues developing high‑melt fibers and polypropylene products for the electronics and automotive sectors. The deeper cooperation with AWI builds on this high‑value material base, extending international collaboration into the semiconductor specialty material supply chain and further expanding cross‑industry transformation opportunities.

Guo Qiao reported first‑half‑year consolidated revenue of NT$12.914 billion, a 17% year‑over‑year increase, with Q2 gross margin turning positive from a loss. The company believes that although the petrochemical sector still faces challenges from high oil prices, pressured demand and oversupply, its core operations have improved. Going forward, it will continue to strengthen its product portfolio and operational efficiency while simultaneously advancing high‑value product development and strategic investment positioning.

Zeng said the industry environment is changing; future competitiveness can no longer rely solely on traditional petrochemical scale but must convert existing processes, materials, and industry experience into new value. Guo Qiao will expand high‑tech applications through international collaborations and strategic investments, deepening its product line in specialty materials, electronic chemicals, and low‑carbon‑footprint hydrogen partnerships with major domestic gas firms, while continuously evaluating cross‑domain collaborations and global market opportunities to increase the share of high‑value transformation and long‑term operational resilience.

items.title: 鴻海擬出清美國金融科技公司Figure Technology Solutions持股 實現投資利益
items.title_en: Foxconn Plans to Liquidate Its Stake in US Fintech Company Figure Technology Solutions to Realize Investment Gains
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(24)日代子公司HCM International Company公告，董事會決議擬出清持有的美國金融科技公司Figure Technology Solutions(FIGR-US)263.28萬股，處分目的為實現投資利益，實際處分價格及交易總金額將依實際處分價格計算後另行公告。
鴻海指出，截至目前，HCM International持有Figure Technology Solutions普通股263.28萬股，持有金額為8058.43萬美元，持股比例1.18%。Figure Technology Solutions主要提供區塊鏈原生資本市場平台，業務涵蓋房屋淨值貸款、消費信貸、資產代幣化等，並透過Figure Connect、DART等平台提供相關金融服務。
此外，鴻海代子公司Joyspeed Global Cargo (China) Limited公告，董事會決議處分上海印華國際貨運代理有限公司股權，交易總金額為人民幣8600萬元，交易對象為準時達國際供應鏈管理有限公司，雙方為母子公司，處分目的為優化集團股權架構。
而準時達國際供應鏈管理有限公司取得上海印華股權上海印華100%股權後，將對其進行人民幣5.5億元現金增資，兩個交易合計投入人民幣6.36億元，資金來源為自有資金，具體目的為優化集團股權架構及長期投資。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today, via its subsidiary HCM International Company, that its board has resolved to liquidate its holding of 2,632,800 shares of US fintech firm Figure Technology Solutions (FIGR‑US). The disposal is intended to realize investment gains, and the actual sale price and total transaction amount will be announced separately after the price is determined.

Foxconn noted that, to date, HCM International holds 2,632,800 ordinary shares of Figure Technology Solutions, valued at US$80.5843 million, representing a 1.18% ownership stake. Figure Technology Solutions primarily provides a blockchain‑native capital markets platform, with services covering home‑equity loans, consumer credit, asset tokenization, and offers related financial services through platforms such as Figure Connect and DART.

In addition, Foxconn, on behalf of its subsidiary Joyspeed Global Cargo (China) Limited, announced that its board resolved to dispose of the equity of Shanghai Yinhua International Freight Forwarding Co., Ltd. The total transaction amount is RMB 86 million, with the buyer being Zhongshi Da International Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd., a parent‑subsidiary affiliate. The disposal aims to optimise the group’s equity structure.

After Zhongshi Da International Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. acquires 100% of Shanghai Yinhua’s equity, it will inject RMB 550 million in cash as a capital increase. The two transactions together involve a total investment of RMB 636 million, funded from its own resources, with the specific purpose of optimising the group’s equity structure and supporting long‑term investment.

items.title: 玉山金首波注資三商壽160億元將到位 現增基準日敲定9/29
items.title_en: E.Sun Financial Announces First NT$16 billion Capital Injection into Sanshang Life, Base Date Set for Sep 29
paras: 玉山金控(2884-TW)代旗下壽險子公司三商美邦人壽今(24)日發布重大訊息，正式公告私募發行普通股之現金增資基準日定於 9 月 29 日。本次現金增資發行總金額為新台幣 160 億元，發行股數為 7.8 億股，每股發行價格約 20.51 元，由母公司玉山金控 100% 全數認購。玉山金董事長黃男州日前表示，明(2027)年將再注資 60 億元，無須向股東伸手拿錢。
玉山金控於今年 9 月 1 日正式合併三商美邦人壽後，隨即啟動資產強化計畫。黃男州先前於法人說明會中明確指出，三商壽併入集團後的首要目標是「Back to Health(恢復健康)」，並規劃於今年與明年合計注資 220 億元，全數由金控現增承擔，無需向外部股東籌資。
隨著今日重訊公布，第一階段 160 億元資金將於 9 月 29 日完成繳納與注資，主要用於增加自有資本、充實營運資金、強化財務結構並提升資本適足率。根據玉山金控規劃，在今年 160 億元資金注入後，預估三商壽年底的 TIS(資本適足)可達 125% 的健康標準；明年預計將再挹注 60 億元，進一步完成資本結構強化。
除了資本面挹注，玉山金控也將從商品結構、銷售通路、數位科技及資產管理四大面向推進改革，帶動壽險業務重回健全成長軌道。
此外，金控整合綜效亦同步推進，公平會已於昨(23)日審查通過玉山金控取得「三商美邦保險代理人」全部股份之結合案，認定該併購對國內保險代理人市場結構影響有限，無顯著限制競爭疑慮，決議不禁止結合。隨著子公司資本與業務通路的陸續整併到位，玉山金控的金控版圖綜效可望加速顯現。
paras_en: E.Sun Financial Holding (2884‑TW) announced on the 24th that its life‑insurance subsidiary Sanshang Meibang Life will conduct a private placement of common stock, setting the cash‑increase base date for September 29. The total amount of the cash increase is NT$160 billion, representing 780 million shares at an issue price of about NT$20.51 per share, fully subscribed by the parent company E.Sun Financial Holding. Chairman Huang Nan‑zhou said a further NT$6 billion will be injected next year, without needing to draw funds from shareholders.

E.Sun Financial Holding formally merged Sanshang Meibang Life on September 1 of this year and immediately launched an asset‑strengthening plan. In a prior corporate briefing, Chairman Huang clarified that the primary goal after integrating Sanshang Life into the group is “Back to Health,” and the group plans to inject a total of NT$22 billion over this year and next, all funded by the holding company’s cash increase, with no external shareholder financing required.

With today’s major announcement, the first‑stage NT$160 billion will be paid and injected by September 29, mainly to boost core capital, replenish operating funds, strengthen the financial structure and improve the capital adequacy ratio. E.Sun Financial Holding projects that after this year’s NT$160 billion injection, Sanshang Life’s TIS (capital adequacy) will reach the healthy 125 % standard by year‑end; a further NT$6 billion is expected next year to further solidify the capital structure.

Beyond capital support, E.Sun Financial Holding will also drive reforms across four key areas – product structure, sales channels, digital technology and asset management – to steer life‑insurance business back onto a sound growth trajectory.

In addition, the holding‑company synergy is being advanced in parallel. The Fair Trade Commission approved on the 23rd the merger whereby E.Sun Financial Holding acquires all shares of “Sanshang Meibang Insurance Agents,” concluding that the acquisition has limited impact on the domestic insurance‑agent market structure and poses no significant competition concerns, thus not prohibiting the combination. As subsidiary capital and distribution channels are progressively integrated, the overall synergy of E.Sun Financial Holding’s financial‑holding map is expected to materialize more quickly.

items.title: 台塑化：向台朔重工斥資3.06億添購生產機械 以因應業務需求
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Corp.: Invests NT$306 million to Purchase Production Machinery from Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries to Meet Business Needs
paras: 台塑化(6505-TW)於今(24)日下午於證交所召開重訊，由副總經理暨代理發言人蔡健堂對外說明。蔡健堂表示，台塑化自去(2025) 9月25日起至今日9月24日止，因應業務需求，向台朔重工購置生產用機械設備，總價款約為新台幣3.06億元。
蔡健堂表示，此次向關係人台朔重工購買設備為台塑化公司業務需要，主要購買設備包括地面燃燒塔、換熱器等設備，金額約2.41億元，以及其他零星設備及工程金額約有6,553萬元。
蔡健堂指出，該公告取得資產金額中，有3億688萬9千元中，其中有1億8,615萬1千元已經交由審計委員會及董事會決議通過，1億2,073萬8千元將提報今(2026)年11月5日審計委員會及董事會討論辦理。
此次台塑化交易相對人為台朔重工(股)公司，為台塑化持股1.26%之轉投資公司。
台朔重工的產品與服務項目，包括汽電共生整廠及發電廠設備、自動倉儲、煉油與石化製程設備、重件運輸與吊裝、齒輪減速機與大型精密齒輪、工業用滾輪、裡襯、金屬輥輪電鍍研磨及電解拋光等，為台灣具規模的機械設備製造及整廠統包廠商。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics Corp. (6505‑TW) held a major announcement this afternoon (the 24th) at the Taiwan Stock Exchange, with Deputy General Manager and acting spokesperson Cai Jiantang speaking to the public. Cai said that from September 25, 2025 until today, September 24, the company, in response to business demand, purchased production machinery from Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries for a total price of about NT$306 million.

Cai explained that the equipment bought from the related party Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries is needed for Formosa Plastics’ operations and mainly includes ground‑burner towers, heat exchangers and similar items, amounting to roughly NT$241 million, plus additional miscellaneous equipment and engineering services costing about NT$65.53 million.

Cai noted that of the announced asset acquisition amount, NT$300.689 million has been partially approved: NT$186.151 million has already been approved by the Audit Committee and the Board of Directors, while NT$120.738 million will be submitted for discussion by the Audit Committee and Board on November 5, 2026.
The counter‑party in this transaction is Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries Co., a subsidiary in which Formosa Plastics holds a 1.26 % equity stake.

Taiwan Shuo Heavy Industries’ product and service portfolio includes cogeneration plant and power‑plant equipment, automated warehousing, refinery and petrochemical process equipment, heavy‑load transport and lifting, gear reducers and large precision gears, industrial rollers, liners, metal rollers with plating, grinding and electropolishing, making it one of Taiwan’s sizable manufacturers and turnkey suppliers of mechanical equipment.

items.title: 〈工資審議〉GDP狂飆薪水卻跟不上？勞長曝關鍵：AI成長紅利並非人人都吃得到
items.title_en: <Wage Review> GDP Soars but Salaries Lag? Labor Minister Reveals Key Issue: AI Growth Benefits Aren’t Reaching Everyone
paras: 台灣今年經濟成長率預估飆上11.05%，但最低工資調幅卻不到5%，「GDP大增、薪資為何沒跟上」成為今年低工資審議最大攻防焦點。最低工資審議會今（24）日歷經約7.5小時協商，拍板2027年起月薪由29,500元調升至30,900元，增加1,400元、調幅4.745%，時薪則由196元提高至205元，最低月薪首度突破3萬元。
為何GDP成長11.05%，最低工資卻只漲4.745%？勞動部長洪申翰會後直指關鍵在於「產業差異」。今年經濟高速成長主要由AI、高科技及半導體等產業拉動，但傳統產業、服務業及中小微企業並未同步享受到相同成長紅利，最低工資若直接與GDP增幅掛鉤，恐加重部分企業的人事成本負擔。
這也使今年審議出現明顯拉鋸。勞方主張經濟成長成果應由勞資共享，會前甚至提出調幅7.77%；資方則強調產業景氣呈現分化，傳產及中小企業承壓，最低工資不能只看漂亮的總體經濟數字。到了最後階段，勞方喊價31,100元、資方守在30,700元，雙方為400元僵持約40分鐘，最終收斂在30,900元。
另一項考量則是通膨。洪申翰指出，消費者物價指數（CPI）應充分反映，幾乎是審議委員共識；至於GDP成長成果該如何分享，則因產業景氣景氣的冷熱不均，成為會議中各方爭執討論最久的部分。
雖然4.745%明顯低於11.05%的GDP成長率，但此次月薪一次增加1,400元，仍創歷來單次調升金額新高。洪申翰解釋，現階段最低工資基期已高於過去，即使百分比增幅沒有突破5%，換算後的實際加薪金額仍高於歷年。此次調整預估共有261.16萬名勞工受惠，其中本國勞工219.72萬人、移工約41.44萬人。
值得注意的是，最低工資上漲也將增加中小企業、傳產及服務業成本壓力。經濟部長龔明鑫先前亦表示，將與勞動部研商產業配套，考慮比照過去受疫情衝擊產業的補貼模式，並研議將適用範圍由製造業擴大至服務業。
若後續經行政院核定，台灣最低工資將迎來連續11年調漲。不過，在AI與半導體推升GDP突破兩位數之際，最低工資僅成長4.745%，也凸顯台灣這波經濟榮景背後的產業K型分化，以及「GDP成長能否真正轉化為全民薪資成長」，仍將是接下來勞動政策的核心課題。
paras_en: Taiwan's economic growth rate is projected to surge to 11.05% this year, yet the minimum wage increase is under 5%. The question of "GDP booming, why wages aren’t keeping pace" has become the central battleground of this year’s low‑wage review. After about 7.5 hours of negotiations, the minimum‑wage committee voted on the 24th to raise the monthly salary from NT$29,500 to NT$30,900 starting in 2027 – an increase of NT$1,400 or 4.745% – and the hourly wage from NT$196 to NT$205, pushing the monthly minimum above NT$30,000 for the first time.

Why does a GDP growth of 11.05% translate into only a 4.745% rise in the minimum wage? Labor Minister Hong Shen‑han said after the meeting that the key lies in "industry differences." This year’s rapid growth is driven mainly by AI, high‑tech and semiconductor sectors, while traditional industries, services and small‑and‑medium enterprises have not shared the same growth dividend. Tying the minimum wage directly to GDP growth could burden some firms with higher labor costs.

This divergence created a clear tug‑of‑war in the review. Labor representatives argued that the fruits of economic growth should be shared between labor and capital, even proposing a 7.77% increase before the meeting. Employers stressed that industry performance is uneven, with traditional sectors and SMEs under pressure, and that the minimum wage cannot be set solely by attractive macro‑economic figures. In the final round, labor demanded NT$31,100, employers held at NT$30,700, a NT$400 gap that lasted about 40 minutes before both sides settled on NT$30,900.

Another consideration was inflation. Hong noted that the consumer price index (CPI) should be fully reflected – a point on which the committee members largely agreed. How the GDP growth dividend should be shared, however, sparked the longest debate, given the uneven heat and cold across industries.

Although the 4.745% rise is far below the 11.05% GDP growth, the one‑time NT$1,400 monthly increase sets a new record for the highest single adjustment amount. Hong explained that the current baseline for the minimum wage is already higher than in the past, so even without a 5% percentage jump, the real‑term raise is larger than in previous years. The adjustment is expected to benefit 2.6116 million workers, including 2.1972 million domestic workers and about 414,400 migrant workers.

It is noteworthy that the higher minimum wage will also raise cost pressures on SMEs, traditional industries and the service sector. Economic Affairs Minister Gong Ming‑xin previously said the Ministry of Economic Affairs will work with the Labor Ministry on industry‑specific support measures, considering a subsidy model similar to that used for sectors hit by the pandemic and expanding the coverage from manufacturing to services.

If the Executive Yuan approves the proposal, Taiwan’s minimum wage will see its 11th consecutive annual increase. Yet, as AI and semiconductors push GDP growth into double‑digit territory, the modest 4.745% wage rise highlights the K‑shaped industrial divide behind this economic boom and raises the core policy question of whether GDP growth can truly translate into wage growth for all citizens.

items.title: 騰勢IPO上櫃案再闖一關 1-8月營收6.02億元年增10.61%
items.title_en: Tengshi's IPO Listing Application Clears Another Hurdle, Jan‑Aug Revenue Reaches NT$6.02 B, Up 10.61% YoY
paras: 人體及寵物保健食品開發商騰勢 (7889-TW) 營運成長中，其上櫃申請案再過一關，今(24)日並獲OTC董監聯席會通過，騰勢最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收6967萬元，月減5.49%，年減1.36%，2026年1-8月營收6.02億元，年增10.61%。
目前股本2.07億元的騰勢，在2026年1-6月財報顯示，上半年稅後純益4587萬元，每股純益2.24元。
騰勢整體營運呈現「多品牌分層成長」健全格局，主力品牌持續發揮規模效應並維持穩定營收規模放大，而新興培育品牌則迎來的業績成長，為整體營收挹注良好的成長動能。
騰勢指出，1-8月營收年增率正成長，主要受惠於旗下保健品牌「達摩本草」、「毛孩時代」維持穩健成長，且於官網、酷澎、蝦皮、寵物公園等之數位電商及實體通路齊步成長，尤其在關節/骨骼品類業績表現亮眼。
騰勢除了旗下主力品牌穩定放大營收規模的基本盤外，精準保健與精緻寵物市場的佈局迎來成果收割期，日系的機能調理新品牌「大島生醫」及適口性切入的寵物生醫品牌「奧沛」，兩大新興品牌8月份業績展現年增率高達三位數的成長態勢，堆疊騰勢今年整體營收展現良好的成績。
面對台灣電商市場進入成熟競爭階段，傳統流量紅利消退，平台成長動能與獲利模式正加速面臨轉型壓力，導入 AI 技術進行精準行銷已成勝出關鍵。騰勢指出，公司近年來憑藉深厚且成熟的電商操作經驗為基石，全面引進 CDP 顧客數據平台與 AI 自動化行銷工具，深度整合會員消費軌跡。
騰勢透過 AI 演算法大數據分析，官網上今年累積年增2倍 會員的消費能量，公司能精準預測消費者的回購週期與潛在需求，並有效減少無效廣告投放，將行銷資源精準集中於「高轉換率、高客單價」的明星產品組合。這套 AI 精準行銷策略不僅顯著提升了廣告 ROI 與會員忠誠度，更直接轉化為強勁的銷售動能，推升官網等數位電商通路的業績持續放量，不僅帶動達摩本草、大島生醫、優固倍等旗艦品牌營收屢創新高。
騰勢2026年1-8月營收來自電商平台的營收明顯年增19.98%，展現出高度效益化的科技電商實力。
paras_en: Human and pet health supplement developer Tengshi (7889‑TW) is experiencing operational growth, and its OTC listing application has cleared another hurdle, receiving approval from the OTC Board and Supervisory Joint Meeting today (24th). The latest revenue figures show that August 2026 revenue was NT$69.67 million, down 5.49% month‑over‑month and 1.36% year‑over‑year, while revenue for January‑August 2026 totaled NT$6.02 billion, up 10.61% year‑over‑year.
With a current share capital of NT$2.07 billion, Tengshi's financial report for the first half of 2026 shows a net profit after tax of NT$45.87 million, or NT$2.24 earnings per share.

Tengshi's overall operations exhibit a "multi‑brand tiered growth" model. Its core brands continue to leverage scale effects and maintain stable revenue expansion, while emerging cultivated brands are delivering performance growth that injects strong momentum into total revenue.

The company notes that the year‑over‑year revenue growth for January‑August is driven mainly by its health brands "Damo Herbal" and "Mao Hai Era," which posted steady growth across both digital channels (official website, Ku Peng, Shopee, Pet Park) and physical retail, with particularly strong performance in the joint/bone health category.

Beyond the solid base of its core brands, Tengshi's strategic focus on precision health and premium pet markets is entering a harvest phase. The Japanese functional‑care brand "Oshima Biotech" and the palatable pet biotech brand "Aopei" both recorded triple‑digit year‑over‑year growth in August, stacking onto Tengshi's overall strong revenue results for the year.

Facing a mature and competitive Taiwanese e‑commerce market where traditional traffic dividends are fading, platform growth momentum and profit models are under rapid transformation pressure. Implementing AI‑driven precision marketing has become a key success factor. Tengshi says that, building on its deep and mature e‑commerce expertise, it has fully adopted a CDP customer‑data platform and AI automation marketing tools to deeply integrate member purchase journeys.

Through AI algorithms and big‑data analysis, Tengshi has doubled the purchasing power of members on its official website this year. The company can accurately predict consumers' repurchase cycles and latent needs, reducing ineffective ad spend and concentrating marketing resources on "high‑conversion, high‑ticket‑price" star product portfolios. This AI‑driven precision marketing strategy has markedly improved ad ROI and member loyalty, directly translating into strong sales momentum that continues to lift performance across digital channels, driving flagship brands such as Damo Herbal, Oshima Biotech, and Yougu Bei to record‑high revenues.

Revenue from e‑commerce platforms accounted for a clear 19.98% year‑over‑year increase in Tengshi's January‑August 2026 sales, demonstrating the highly efficient, technology‑enabled e‑commerce capability.

items.title: Meta搶先OpenAI進軍AI硬體「Muse Charm」鑰匙圈最快12月上市
items.title_en: Meta Beats OpenAI to AI Hardware with "Muse Charm" Keychain Set to Launch as Early as December
paras: Meta Platforms (META-US)正在加速將人工智慧從手機App帶進專用硬體，執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)在年度Connect大會上公布Muse Charm，一款可掛在鑰匙圈上的小型AI裝置，讓使用者不必解鎖手機或開啟App，就能直接與Meta的AI代理Muse互動。
Meta預計在今年12月推出Muse Charm，這也讓公司在消費型AI硬體市場搶在OpenAI之前亮相。
Muse Charm是Meta將Muse從軟體服務延伸至實體裝置的重要一步。裝置體積接近口袋大小，配備約2吋螢幕、指紋感測器與5G數據機，螢幕主要顯示Muse的角色，而非像智慧型手機般運行各種App。使用者可以透過語音、觸控及相機與Muse互動，指紋感測則提供啟動方式。Meta尚未公布Muse Charm售價，目前也僅製作少量原型機，預計在正式上市前完成產品定型。
Muse Charm背後真正的核心並非硬體，而是Meta希望建立的個人AI代理。Muse於9月8日推出，能代表使用者執行多步驟任務，例如撰寫及寄送電子郵件、安排旅行、處理表格、購物，甚至代表使用者進行部分交易。Muse目前提供免費版本，另有每月20美元及100美元的訂閱方案，分別面向一般及高強度使用者。
Muse推出後初期成長速度相當快。根據App數據公司Apptopia資料，Muse在上市前12天累計下載量達280萬次；若採用相同口徑比較，ChatGPT同期約為130萬次。Muse目前僅在美國及加拿大提供下載，但早期用戶反應已成為市場重新評估Meta AI策略的重要因素。
Reuters報導指出，Muse推出後Meta股價一度累計上漲逾20%, 市值增加超過2000億美元，並升至7個多月來高點。市場對Muse的早期採用速度及商業化潛力反應積極，不過這些市場表現主要反映投資人對未來AI收入的預期，尚不能代表Muse已經建立長期且可持續的商業模式。
Jefferies估計，如果Muse到2027年底能達到10億名用戶，並有至少3%的用戶轉換為付費方案，年化營收可能達到108億美元。這項數字屬於券商情境估算，而非Meta公布的財測。J.P. Morgan則認為，Muse具備成為ChatGPT推出後最廣泛使用的消費型AI應用之一的潛力，主要原因包括多步驟任務能力、Meta龐大的既有用戶基礎，以及免費方案降低使用門檻。
Meta的AI策略並不只依賴Muse App。公司表示，Muse將在未來數月導入AI眼鏡，讓使用者可以直接透過眼鏡呼叫AI代理，並讓Muse根據使用者眼前看到的商品、傳單或其他物體採取行動。Meta預計到今年底，旗下Ray-Ban、Oakley及Meta品牌AI眼鏡的款式將超過100種。

在Connect大會上，Meta也宣布擴大Muse的外部服務整合，包括Walmart、Best Buy、American Eagle Outfitters、DICK'S Sporting Goods、Fanatics、Gap、Michael Kors、Sephora、Ulta及Wayfair等零售商，並加入Shop Pay及PayPal作為支付工具。Expedia將用於旅遊規劃，Instacart則可協助採購食品，另外還將連接Notion、Granola、GitHub及Box等工作工具。
Meta同時為每個Muse代理提供專屬電子郵件地址，讓AI代理能透過電子郵件處理任務或與使用者溝通。公司還公布即時語音對話、自訂聲音及Live Video等功能，試圖讓Muse從傳統聊天機器人進一步轉型為能夠持續代表使用者執行任務的個人AI代理。
這套策略也讓Meta在消費型AI硬體領域暫時取得時間優勢。OpenAI已投入數十億美元建立硬體部門，並與前蘋果(Apple, AAPL-US)首席設計長Jony Ive合作開發新型AI裝置，但目前尚未公布正式產品。市場目前預期OpenAI的首款裝置可能要到2027年才會推出，因此Meta搶先公開Muse Charm，等於提前進入這個仍未形成明確產品標準的新市場。
祖克柏對AI硬體的押注其實也延續Meta過去多年的硬體策略。公司先前投入大量資金發展虛擬實境、擴增實境及智慧眼鏡，並將Reality Labs視為下一代運算平台的重要布局。不過，這些業務長期處於高投入階段，Muse則讓Meta有機會把既有硬體生態與AI服務結合，形成不同於單純販售裝置的商業模式。
Meta第二季營收達608.01億美元, 年增28%; 營業利益187.75億美元, 年減8%; 淨利158.48億美元, 年減14%。截至6月底, Meta每日活躍用戶達36億人, 年增3%。公司預估2026年資本支出將達1300億至1450億美元, 顯示其AI資料中心、運算基礎設施及新產品開發仍需要極高資本投入。
Meta第二季資本支出達310.8億美元, 同時截至6月底持有現金、現金等價物及有價證券約902.6億美元, 長期債務為836.6億美元。公司也在2026年5月進行人力縮減, 第二季計入11.8億美元遣散費, 截至6月底員工人數為7.55萬人。
不過, Muse與Muse Charm能否真正改變消費者使用AI的方式, 目前仍存在不少未知數。AI硬體過去已有多個案例未能形成大眾市場, 包括Rabbit R1及Humane AI Pin等產品。Muse Charm必須證明自己能提供手機、智慧手錶或AI眼鏡無法輕易取代的功能, 同時還要讓消費者願意將購物、電子郵件、旅遊及其他個人資料交給AI代理處理。
信任問題也是Meta能否擴大Muse商業模式的重要關鍵。Visa近期調查顯示, 美國消費者使用AI助理的比例已達72%, 但願意讓AI直接代為付款的比例僅23%。這代表消費者可能願意使用AI協助搜尋與規劃, 但對於讓AI掌握支付及交易權限仍相對謹慎。

對Meta而言, Muse Charm因此不只是另一款硬體產品, 而是祖克柏試圖建立「個人超級智慧」生態系的實驗。Meta希望讓AI代理成為連接社交、購物、工作、旅遊與日常生活的核心入口, 再透過手機、AI眼鏡及專用裝置提供無縫接觸。如今Meta已在OpenAI正式推出硬體前率先把產品推向市場, 但祖克柏這套以AI代理加上自有硬體建立新消費平台的策略, 最終能否形成大規模使用及穩定收入, 仍有待市場與消費者進一步驗證。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) is accelerating the move of artificial intelligence from mobile apps to dedicated hardware. CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced Muse Charm at the annual Connect conference – a small AI device that can be attached to a keychain, allowing users to interact with Meta’s AI agent Muse without unlocking a phone or opening an app.
Meta plans to launch Muse Charm in December this year, giving the company a first‑mover advantage in the consumer AI‑hardware market ahead of OpenAI.

Muse Charm marks a key step for Meta in extending Muse from a software service to a physical device. The pocket‑sized gadget features a roughly 2‑inch screen, a fingerprint sensor and a 5G modem. The screen mainly displays Muse’s avatar rather than running a suite of apps like a smartphone. Users can interact with Muse via voice, touch and camera, while the fingerprint sensor serves as an activation method. Meta has not disclosed pricing and has only produced a limited number of prototypes, with final product specifications to be locked in before the official launch.

The real core behind Muse Charm is not the hardware but Meta’s personal AI agent. Muse, launched on September 8, can act on behalf of users to perform multi‑step tasks such as drafting and sending emails, planning trips, handling forms, shopping, and even executing certain transactions. Muse is offered for free, with paid tiers of $20 per month and $100 per month aimed at regular and power users respectively.

Muse’s early growth has been rapid. According to app‑analytics firm Apptopia, Muse accumulated 2.8 million downloads in the 12 days before its launch; by the same metric, ChatGPT logged about 1.3 million downloads in the comparable period. Muse is currently available only in the United States and Canada, but early user feedback has already become a key factor in reassessing Meta’s AI strategy.

Reuters reported that Meta’s share price rose more than 20 % after Muse’s debut, adding over $200 billion to market value and reaching a seven‑month high. The market’s enthusiastic response reflects investors’ expectations for future AI revenue, but it does not yet prove that Muse has built a sustainable, long‑term business model.

Jefferies estimates that if Muse reaches 1 billion users by the end of 2027 and at least 3 % convert to paid plans, annual revenue could hit $10.8 billion. This is a brokerage scenario, not a figure disclosed by Meta. J.P. Morgan sees Muse as having the potential to become one of the most widely used consumer AI applications since ChatGPT, citing its multi‑step task capability, Meta’s massive existing user base, and the low barrier of a free tier.

Meta’s AI strategy is not limited to the Muse app. The company says Muse will be integrated into AI glasses in the coming months, allowing users to summon the agent directly through eyewear and have Muse act on items the user sees – such as products, flyers or other objects. Meta expects that by year‑end it will offer more than 100 styles of AI glasses under the Ray‑Ban, Oakley and Meta brands.

At Connect, Meta also announced an expansion of Muse’s external service integrations, adding retailers such as Walmart, Best Buy, American Eagle Outfitters, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Fanatics, Gap, Michael Kors, Sephora, Ulta and Wayfair, as well as payment options Shop Pay and PayPal. Expedia will be used for travel planning, Instacart for grocery ordering, and connections will also be made to productivity tools like Notion, Granola, GitHub and Box.

Meta will assign each Muse agent a dedicated email address so the AI can handle tasks or communicate with users via email. The company also unveiled real‑time voice conversation, custom voice, and Live Video features, aiming to evolve Muse from a traditional chatbot into a personal AI agent that continuously acts on the user’s behalf.

This strategy gives Meta a temporary time advantage in the consumer AI‑hardware space. OpenAI has invested billions in building a hardware division and is collaborating with former Apple chief design officer Jony Ive on a new AI device, but no product has been announced yet. The market expects OpenAI’s first device not until 2027, so Meta’s early reveal of Muse Charm effectively puts it ahead in a market that has yet to settle on clear product standards.

Zuckerberg’s bet on AI hardware continues Meta’s long‑standing hardware playbook. The company has previously poured capital into virtual reality, augmented reality and smart glasses, treating Reality Labs as a next‑generation computing platform. Those businesses remain high‑investment for the long term, while Muse gives Meta a chance to combine its existing hardware ecosystem with AI services, creating a model that differs from pure device sales.
